payload.justification: The door is locked and I carry no item to unlock it. The box is a visible, unlocked container that may hold a usable item.
payload.expected_outcome: The box opens and reveals its contents, or reports that it cannot be opened.
payload.subgoal: Find an item to unlock the door
plan: Pick up a usable item if one is found
Try to unlock the door with it
Go through the door if it opens
